Lines going up from left to right have a positive gradient; lines going down have a negative gradient; flat lines have a gradient of zero.
Coordinates are written (x, y). The first number is how far across, the second is how far up.
Work out the top and the bottom first, then divide the top by the bottom.
Replace the letter with the number, multiply first, then add or subtract.
